_note: The neutral knobs of the domain specialists (id158, or68). The specialists themselves are not listed here: server/ai/specialists.mjs derives one per code part of the project's architecture map. nativeRoles: the roles of server/ai/agents.json that also get their own agent file (they isolate context or verify independently); the builder roles (coder, debugger, designer, writer) are carried by the domain specialists instead. builder: the kinds of task a domain specialist takes, the kind whose policy row gives its model and level (primary), and the tool classes it carries. toolClasses: how the neutral classes (read, edit, shell) are spelled by each AI that can narrow tools per agent; Codex cannot (sandbox and tools follow the parent session), so its guarantee is the isolated copy and the exit gates. cardMaxBytes: the ceiling of the card, which is input tokens on every call of the specialist (id150).
